name: Processor D
design_rationale: The four logical asset qubits map to a fully connected K4 core so all pairwise interactions in the dense portfolio QUBO are physically adjacent, targeting routing overhead measured on the sparse reference graphs. A fifth connected qubit provides a distance-2 pair for the required Bell comparison; it is not assumed to improve the four-logical-qubit circuit automatically. Re-benchmark on the locked Phase 2 instance before claiming improvement.
